title: Frequency, Wavelength and Speed
summary: Amplitude, frequency, time period and wavelength; pitch and loudness; and the wave equation v = fλ.
objectives: I can define amplitude, frequency, time period and wavelength.
I can use v = fλ and T = 1/f.
I can link pitch to frequency and loudness to amplitude.
misconceptions: A higher-pitched sound has a bigger amplitude.
Sound travels at the same speed in every material.
